description: Post-processing / consistency layer for Model 1 + Model 3 outputs. Operates on model outputs only; no model weights involved.

threshold_derivation.criterion: max Youden's J (correct vs incorrect fruit predictions) on the VAL pool
threshold_derivation.val_pool: Model 1 VAL split (1,299) + Model 3 new-split VAL images (364)

R1_low_fruit_confidence.description: If Model 1 fruit confidence < threshold: quality_grade = 'Uncertain', shelf_life = not_available; fruit prediction kept; routed head outputs kept only under raw.

R2_grade_vs_stage.description: Grade and shelf-life stage come from DIFFERENT heads/datasets (banana only). Ordinal convention Good~Fresh, Average~Semi-fresh, Poor~Rotten. |grade index - stage index| = 1 -> 'minor_mismatch' note; = 2 -> 'contradiction' warning. Neither prediction is altered.

not_applicable.tomato: grade and stage are the same head output
not_applicable.brinjal: grade and stage are the same head output

R3_condition_vs_grade.description: Model 1 condition and Model 3 grade disagree in the strong sense: condition 'fresh' with grade 'Poor', or condition 'spoiled' with grade 'Good'. Warning only; neither prediction is altered.
